title: Mara and the Harvest
author: Tamsin Ravensworth
blurb: Mirabel Zhou, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, has spent five years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
